requirement_coverage.R18: Signed stop controls deny new fixture recovery/permit work, not a claim of production emergency-stop delivery or remote read reconciliation.
requirement_coverage.R32: Typed intent and cycle cases are opened and inspected by workspace; no replacement cycle is created for review/retry.

requirement_coverage.R35: Terminalize and archive through signed fixture commands preserve one immutable archive and exact repeated public response; production discovery/retention qualification remains open.
